Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Men and women, 18 years of age or older
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient is a 58-year-old male, satisfying the age and gender requirement.
The patient has coronary artery disease classified as Stage III with multivessel involvement and impaired left ventricular function, confirming left ventricular failure.
The heart biopsy performed at age 55 revealed ischemic cardiomyopathy, not myocarditis, and no other biopsy-documented myocarditis is mentioned in the patient profile.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: N/A (No exclusion criteria provided in the trial criteria)
